project.title: Vivhite — a mathematical magic-girl character for Slay the Spire 2

narration.zh-CN: 她是白绮，一位用魔法书写几何与星算的魔法师。
narration.en: This is Vivhite, a mage who writes geometry and star calculus as magic.

title.en: It starts with the opening hand

narration.zh-CN: 弦光投影、闭域映射、白绮的变身式和孤高冠冕，组成她的第一道证明。
narration.en: Luminous Projection, Closed Domain Mapping, Vivhite's Transformation, and Solitary Crown form the first proof.

narration.zh-CN: 謦欬在效果发生前支付实际生命，但白绮不会因此跌到一点以下。
narration.en: Cough pays real life before the effect, while Vivhite never falls below one HP.

subtitles.en: Cough: life is the casting cost

title.en: Margin: turn the difference into defense

narration.zh-CN: 余裕按一比一抵扣謦欬，让一次冒险变成下一次防守的准备。
narration.en: Margin offsets Cough one for one, turning risk into the next defense.

subtitles.zh-CN: 余裕按一比一抵扣謦欬
subtitles.en: Margin offsets Cough one for one

title.zh-CN: 汲取：伤害最终会回到你身上

narration.zh-CN: 汲取等待整张攻击结算，再把敌人真正失去的生命一次收回。
narration.en: Drain waits for the whole attack, then returns the enemy's actual loss at once.

subtitles.zh-CN: 汲取：按实际伤害统一回收

narration.zh-CN: 守恒几何把生命、格挡和能量放进同一张可计算的图。
narration.en: Conservation Geometry places life, block, and energy on one calculable diagram.

subtitles.zh-CN: 守恒几何：资源可以互相证明
subtitles.en: Conservation Geometry: resources prove each other

narration.zh-CN: 递归星算让每一次增维都成为下一次计算的起点。
narration.en: Recursive Star Calculus turns every dimension up into the next calculation's starting point.

subtitles.zh-CN: 递归星算：增长也是输入
subtitles.en: Recursive Star Calculus: growth is input

narration.zh-CN: 绯彩积分把汲取、抽牌与终结压缩成一条绯色的积分路径。
narration.en: Crimson Integral compresses Drain, draw, and termination into one scarlet path.

subtitles.zh-CN: 绯彩积分：把伤害变成循环
subtitles.en: Crimson Integral: turn damage into a loop

narration.zh-CN: 统一场论把不同花色的路径接在一起，寻找同一个闭环。
narration.en: Unified Field Theory joins the different suits and searches for one closed loop.

subtitles.en: Unified Field Theory: a cross-system loop

title.en: Take the proof up the Spire

narration.zh-CN: 六十一张专属卡牌、三套构筑，以及一个仍在生长的魔法师。
narration.en: Sixty-one signature cards, three archetypes, and a mage that keeps growing.

subtitles.zh-CN: 白绮：61 张卡，3 套构筑
